dialogues.speaker: Darina
dialogues.text: I haven't been able to dream ever since I grew up, but still, one should dream big.

dialogues.speaker: Darina
dialogues.text: Good luck will follow only if you dream big!

dialogues.speaker: Darina
dialogues.text: Maybe one day, King Deshret or Greater Lord Rukkhadevata will come back again...

dialogues.speaker: Darina
dialogues.text: Either will do. Upon their return, there will be no desert, no pain, no Samiel-Control Engineers, no Bimarstan's doctors.

dialogues.speaker: Darina
dialogues.text: Hehehe, just saying this cracks me up.
